description: India outbound education remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS): annual cap and tax collected at source (TCS). Draft: secondary sources only. Check every rule against RBI and Income Tax Department sources before relying on it.

lrs_annual_cap_usd.unit: USD per individual per financial year (April to March)
lrs_annual_cap_usd.source: Chandan's own research document (India Cross-Border Remittance, May 2026)
lrs_annual_cap_usd.check_against: RBI LRS FAQs and Master Direction
lrs_annual_cap_usd.note: Counts all LRS purposes together. Secondary sources agree on USD 250,000; RBI primary text not yet checked, so kept unverified.

tcs_threshold_inr.unit: INR per PAN per financial year
tcs_threshold_inr.check_against: Income-tax Act 2025 s.394(1), Table Sl. 7-8 (was 1961 Act s.206C(1G)); Finance Act 2026
tcs_threshold_inr.note: Budget 2025 raised the threshold from 7 lakh to 10 lakh.

tcs_threshold_aggregates_all_purposes.check_against: Income-tax Act 2025 s.394(1), Table Sl. 7-8 (was 1961 Act s.206C(1G)); Finance Act 2026
tcs_threshold_aggregates_all_purposes.note: The threshold is counted across LRS remittances for the individual in the financial year. Open question: since FY 2026-27 tour packages have no threshold; unclear whether they still count toward the 10 lakh.

tcs_rate_education_self_funded.unit: rate on the amount above the threshold
tcs_rate_education_self_funded.check_against: Income-tax Act 2025 s.394(1), Table Sl. 7-8 (was 1961 Act s.206C(1G)); Finance Act 2026

tcs_rate_education_loan_funded.check_against: Income-tax Act 2025 s.394(1), Table Sl. 7-8 (was 1961 Act s.206C(1G)); Finance Act 2026
tcs_rate_education_loan_funded.note: Applies to education funded by a loan from a notified financial institution.

tcs_rate_no_pan.unit: rate on the amount above the threshold
tcs_rate_no_pan.check_against: Income-tax Act 2025 provision replacing 1961 Act s.206CC
tcs_rate_no_pan.note: Bank FAQ and one 2026 guide list 5% for education without PAN/Aadhaar (higher of twice the rate or 5%). Confirm in the 2025 Act.

tcs_prior_other_purposes_count_toward_th.check_against: Income-tax Act 2025 s.394(1), Table Sl. 7-8 (was 1961 Act s.206C(1G)); Finance Act 2026
tcs_prior_other_purposes_count_toward_th.note: Assumes earlier remittances for other purposes use up the 10 lakh threshold, so the whole education amount is taxed at the education rate.

tcs_base_excludes_fees.note: TCS is computed on the remitted amount, not on fees. Confirm with a bank.

gst_on_service_charge.note: GST applies to conversion and remittance service charges. The rate is taken from each route's own fee schedule.
